name: Light Glass (harness only)
author: amee-store devtools
description: Not a theme Amee ships. It exists because every bundled theme is dark, so a skin that hard-codes white text, a dark drop shadow, or a translucent black surface looks correct against all three — and then a user imports a light theme and it becomes unreadable. Preview against this before you publish.

tokens.--font: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', Inter, Avenir, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
